note: Summaries of each retailer's published return policy, read from the section that applies to the product group (beauty, electronics or everything else). Each rule carries the date it was checked. Only short phrases are quoted. A rule marked unknown is treated as not returnable once opened.

retailers.name: Sephora

rules.conditions: Refund for items in "new or gently used" condition within 30 days of purchase.

retailers.notes: Read from Sephora's returns page in full on 2026-11-08. Holiday purchases from Oct 30 to Dec 31, 2026 can come back through Jan 31, 2027.

rules.conditions: Refund for "new or gently used" products within 30 days. Days 31-60 give merchandise credit only. All original components, proof of purchase and a government ID are required.
Most beauty items can be returned "even if opened" within 90 days with a receipt (120 with a Target Circle Card).

Electronics come back within 30 days (a longer window for holiday purchases). Opened electronics are not on the exchange-only list, so the general rule applies: opened items "may be denied a refund or exchange".
Refunds cover "most unopened items" in new condition within 90 days. Opened items "may be denied a refund or exchange".

retailers.name: CVS Pharmacy

rules.conditions: Beauty products come back "opened or unopened" with a receipt or invoice at any CVS Pharmacy store, subject to a third-party return authorization. The beauty section states no time limit.
Most new, unopened items within 60 days. Opened items "may be denied a refund or exchange".

retailers.notes: The beauty rule comes from the beauty section of CVS's return policy page, which states no time limit; the general rule from CVS's returns PDF, whose 60 days covers new, unopened items. The page's beauty section overrides the PDF for beauty.

rules.conditions: Cosmetics returns are "at the discretion of the store manager", usually as a Walgreens gift card. Eligible items within 30 days with a receipt.
Electronics returns are at the store manager's discretion, usually as a gift card.
Eligible items within 30 days with the receipt or order number. The page does not say whether opened items qualify.

retailers.name: Kohl's

rules.conditions: Sephora at Kohl's items in "new or gently used" condition within 30 days of purchase. Some Kohl's store pages say 60 days. This is Kohl's own returns page.
Premium electronics and watches within 30 days with the original packaging. The page does not say whether opened items qualify.
Most merchandise within 90 days (120 with a Kohl's Card), with or without a receipt. Opened condition is not addressed.

retailers.notes: All three rules are from Kohl's returns page (FAQ article 893), read in full on 2026-11-08. A single store's page said 60 days for Sephora at Kohl's (used here from 2026-11-07 to 2026-11-08); Kohl's own page says 30.

rules.conditions: Policies vary by brand. Not checked. Treated as not returnable once opened until the store's page is read.
